prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 2D fighting game animation sprite sheet.
Primary request: Exactly eight full-body poses of Delsa Solórzano, the Venezuelan woman politician, as a recognizable playful editorial caricature for a friendly Venezuelan arcade fighting game. Adult woman with long straight dark brown hair, light olive complexion, defined face and expressive eyebrows. Signature teal turquoise tailored blazer over a white shirt, dark navy fitted pants, black shoes. Athletic confident posture. Same face, outfit, proportions and scale in all eight poses.
Style: polished hand-painted 2D arcade character illustration, bold clean dark ink outlines, strong expressive face slightly enlarged, detailed cel shading, lively but sophisticated, like a modern illustrated fighting game. No pixel art. No realism. 
Composition: one 2048 by 1024 pixel landscape sprite sheet with four equally sized columns and two equally sized rows. Exactly eight complete separate sprites, one centered in each equal cell, generous transparent padding. Every body faces screen-right in three-quarter side view. Full character and all extremities visible inside each cell, feet at same baseline except jump.
Top row left to right: (1) idle ready to fight with hands up, (2) defensive block with forearms crossed, (3) running right left leg forward, (4) running right right leg forward.
Bottom row left to right: (5) leaping with knees tucked, (6) strong straight right-handed punch to the right, (7) high rightward side kick, (8) recoiling backward from a hit.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background. No ground, shadows, floor, scenery, panels, boxes, cell boundaries or background color.
Constraints: exactly eight poses, consistent identity; no text, labels, letters, watermark, effects, detached objects, duplicated limbs, motion trails, or visible grid. The transparent sheet will be sliced into 4x2 cells in code.
